decisions.reason: The mobile check-in app builds on the firm's aviation passenger-processing know-how and its in-house technology development, so the firm can interpret results and improve it as travel recovers and contactless processing is in demand, though apps face more competition and higher risk of being phased out.

PassBoard is a flagship multi-model line launched with explicit announcement, closely related to the firm's core airport security and processing expertise, giving strong absorptive capacity to refine it after the pandemic downturn.

The self-service check-in solution draws on the firm's established airline-client relationships and in-house technology, so the firm can learn from deployments, and post-COVID demand for automated, low-contact passenger handling supports keeping it.
